identity.name: Haven Hotel & Residences
identity.headline: Your Haven in {city}.
identity.heroLead: Calm city stays, with room to make yourself at home.
identity.introduction: Settle into a thoughtfully furnished room in {district}, with space for a short city break, a work trip or a longer stay. Compare four room types, choose your dates and find the stay that suits you.

location.entranceNotes: Sample arrival guide: use the main lobby entrance and present your reservation details at Front Desk. Contact the hotel before arrival if you need assistance.
location.localGuide: Use the Manila city guide to plan your visit. The map pin is a public landmark for this demo, not a real Haven property. Distances from the fictional hotel are not asserted.

amenities.name: Wi-Fi
amenities.description: Complimentary Wi-Fi in guest rooms and shared areas.

amenities.name: Parking
amenities.description: Complimentary self-parking for registered guests, subject to space. Parking is not reserved automatically.

amenities.name: Swimming pool
amenities.description: Outdoor pool for registered guests, open 7:00 AM–9:00 PM. Children require adult supervision.

amenities.name: Fitness room
amenities.description: Fitness room for registered guests, open 6:00 AM–10:00 PM.

amenities.name: Airport transfers
amenities.description: Airport transfers on request. Fare, pickup time and vehicle are confirmed separately before travel.

amenities.name: Laundry
amenities.description: Laundry service on request. The itemised price and collection schedule are confirmed before service.

dining.name: The Haven Table
dining.description: A relaxed all-day dining space serving breakfast and simple comfort dishes.
dining.roomRateBasis: Room-only base rate; breakfast is charged separately unless the selected offer explicitly includes it.

family.summary: Children are welcome and count toward the room’s stated maximum occupancy. Choose a room with enough sleeping space for everyone; no automatic child discount is applied in this demo.
family.extraBeds: Extra beds are not offered in the sample room rates. Ask Front Desk about cot availability and any applicable charge before booking; requests do not increase room capacity.

accessibility.summary: Sample facilities include a step-free lobby entrance and lift access to guest floors. Contact Front Desk to confirm bathroom layout, doorway clearance and any assistance required before choosing a room.

legal.privacyDraft: This fictional hotel preview illustrates the information a hotel may request for account access, reservations and guest support. It does not create accounts, send messages or collect payments. A real client must provide the approved data-handling notice, retention details and privacy contact before launch.
legal.termsDraft: These are sample booking terms for the fictional {name} property. Dates, occupancy, the selected room and applicable rate must be reviewed before submission. A room is held only after guest details are submitted. Confirmation follows verification of the required deposit. Special requests, transfers and early or late arrival arrangements require separate approval.

customFaq.question: Can I ask for help before arrival?
customFaq.answer: Contact Front Desk with your reservation details and any arrival requirements.
